name: Expertise AI
description:
The easiest way to move your Claude skills to Expertise. Connect this connector, say "import this skill to Expertise", and Claude packages the skill files and uploads them to your Expertise account. No zip exports, no manual re-creation.

What you can do:
• Import a skill straight from a conversation, right after you build or refine it
• Preview an import before it runs, so you know exactly what will be created or updated
• Re-import after edits to keep Expertise in sync; unchanged content is detected and skipped automatically
• List everything you've already imported, with a link to each skill

The connector only touches what you point it at: it never reads your chat history, memory, or unrelated files. Once imported, your skills live in your Expertise dashboard, where your team can run them, share them, and build on them.

Requires a free Expertise account at expertise.ai.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Expertise AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Expertise AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.expertise.ai/assist-api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Expertise AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expertise AI provides these MCP tools: expertise_import_skill, expertise_list_imported, expertise_plan_import, and expertise_start_import.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Expertise AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Expertise AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Expertise AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expertise AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Expertise AI is developed by Expertise AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
